title: Mario Coin
blurb: Forty years of players have been neurologically conditioned to feel rewarded by this exact blip, so attaching it to something worthless is comedy gold. Koji Kondo built the coin sound to be short and bright and endlessly repeatable, so that a row of them turns into rhythm rather than noise. Genuinely clever design for hardware with almost no audio channels to spare. Apply it to a penny found in a coat pocket, a participation certificate, or an offer of exposure in lieu of payment. The gold standard of reward sounds, quite literally.
origin: The coin collect from Super Mario Bros. (Nintendo, 1985).
